goal: Integrate bounded original physical evidence into actual context and held-history consumers, preserving live authority, private-read barriers and scientific phase boundaries.
procedure: Expose a targeted actual artifact-row reader; build selected-history-metadata-v1 around registered original and manifest coordinates rather than replaying unrelated events. Reconstruct the exact manifest, preserve all original evaluation grants, and share the terminal row fence with external-disclosure checks. Opt in native phase ancestry explicitly using original IDs. Build selected-current-context-v1 as a finite source view holding the original physical resolver, reuse current Claim/state/private custody checks, preserve actual native phase callbacks, and reject unsupported custom authority or episode custody. Extend selected terminal observations to state heads, versions, activations and rollback lineage after callbacks. Bind domain/cap and target readers to issued histories and live runtime operations. Keep old consumers as defaults and regression fixtures. Correct the discovery inventory to require every discovered case once plus named new physical cases; do not alter budgets to make a gate pass.
authority: Registered locators are not permission or physical presence. Selected proofs cover nominated closure and held originals, not unrelated stream integrity. Initial AEAD authentication, independent owner approvals, scientific phase exclusion and current source/Claim/state authority remain separate required boundaries.
validation: The preceding six exact-source cases passed on actual XTDB/Kurrent in ordinary run 36815981435; its core passed 34 cases. That run still failed both response budgets and the stale 43-case inventory assertion. The inventory repair passed five local cases and current runtime/authentication tests passed locally. New consumer correctness, independent review and physical gate receipts are recorded in the verification checkpoint as they complete; no pending result is inferred.
failure_or_lesson: Switching only the public history fence leaves hidden full replay inside artifact metadata. Copying a policy can silently discard custom authority or native phase gates. Current source/grant/Claim rows alone cannot catch a state head changed by a late callback. Compound checks need a shared terminal basis, and runtime/issued-history domain choices must remain bound. Exact selection requires a distinct integrity contract; a latency pass or learned behavior win does not follow from contract tests.
